messages:
opsbot: INCIDENT ALERT: high error rate + fallback loop detected on routing-policy-service (root ts=2073456789). Symptom: repeated cross-region fallbacks and KV cache reuse across variants. Paging oncall @sara (oncall).

opsbot: auto-signal details: 5xx spike starting 2073456720, fallback loops > 20k reqs/min, cache hit rate abnormal. Link: https://metrics.redwood.internal/alerts/2073456789

sara (oncall): ack, looking. Is there an affected customer list?

lee: saw noisy logs from routing-proxy showing requests for model "rw-llama-7b" being routed to variant "rw-llama-7b-quant" *then* immediately to region fallback us-west-2, but KV lookups returned keys for the previous region/variant.

lee: snippet from proxy logs: ```INFO 2073456741 route_request id=abcd1234 model=rw-llama-7b region=eu-west-1 variant= (empty) fallback=us-west-2 kv_key=rw-llama-7b:eu-west-1```

emily: that kv_key shows variant empty — policy generator probably dropped variant when fallback triggered. If cache is keyed by "model:region:variant" and variant becomes empty we can get collisions across variants.

infra-bot: metric: cache_prefix_mismatch_count = 14,312 (1m avg). Cache namespace shows mixed entries for rw-llama-7b and rw-llama-7b-quant under same prefix.

mike: customer impact: AcmeCorp and 3 other PLG customers reported >30% degraded responses (truncated completions, often from smaller quantized variant). We saw increased rerates and user-facing latency. Open ticket #ENG-4531.

sara (oncall): immediate mitigation options? Can we toggle routing-policy to prefer exact-variant matching or disable prefix cache for affected models?

lee: recommend temporary mitigations in order: 1) disable caching of KV prefixes for models with fallbacks (quick flip in feature flags), 2) deploy a routing policy patch that forces variant to be part of the key even on fallback (patch is small), 3) canary the change to 5% traffic.

emily: config to flip: ```PUT /feature-flags/cache-prefixing { "rw_kv_prefixing": false, "scope": "routing-policy-service" }``` Doing that should force fresh lookups and avoid stale key reuse.

sara (oncall): please run the flip now and monitor. I'll notify support and page AcmeCorp. @jordan please prepare for handoff in 1h.

lee: executing feature flag flip (console). Response: 200 OK. Rolling change across 6 regions.

infra-bot: deploybot: feature-flag-change accepted, rollout started (6 regions). ETA ~90s per region.

mike: flagged support: contacting AcmeCorp workspace + status page update. Notifying CSM.

emily: initial telemetry after flip: cache_hits down 40% for rw-llama-7b (expected) and error-rate trending down. Latency spikes momentary but falling.

lee: we also found a race in policy builder: when fallback region selection happens, the variant field can be set to empty string before the cache key is emitted. I'll open a PR to atomically include the fallback variant in key generation. PR #7845.

sara (oncall): good. We'll keep the flip for now as short-lived mitigation. Documenting steps in incident board. Jordan will take on long-running fix follow-up and customer postmortem.

jordan: taking handoff in 1h. Will coordinate with lee/emily for PR verification and schedule a canary deploy for the policy patch.

opsbot: INCIDENT NOTE: mitigation applied (cache-prefixing disabled), customers notified, handoff scheduled. Incident state: mitigated -> under-investigation.

mike: SLAs: no full outage but degraded quality for subset. Preparing customer impact summary and SLO blameless note.

lee: root cause hypothesis: cache key composition omitted variant on fallback due to race condition between fallback selector and key emitter. Secondary cause: prefix cache TTLs and cross-region replication amplified reuse.

emily: postmortem action items: (1) patch policy builder to always include variant, (2) add unit test for fallback key generation, (3) add metrics/alert for cache_key_collision_rate, (4) limit prefix cache replication for models flagged as fallback-prone.

sara (oncall): thanks team. I'll close the page when we verify steady-state for 30m. Leaving notes for postmortem. :white_check_mark:
